prefill.name: exact selected client.name plus Tour
prefill.area: client.city and client.state; never a claimed search preference
prefill.notes: short client.notes summary; original entry expands in the draft popup

storage.drafts: sessionStorage scoped to the hash of the authenticated Tour session token
storage.files: memory only; no file bytes, names or derived contents are persisted or transmitted

unavailable_operations: private workspace file upload and authorized agent packet compilation
licensed MLS query and listing matches
safety: Unsupported actions stay disabled; catalog search is not MLS search.
No default date, budget, appointment, listing result or navigation coordinate is invented.
Selecting another client clears prior-client values; late responses are discarded.
Background updates refresh the record and tour details without overwriting edited draft fields.
Files are never included in public projection, share or PDF commands.
Territory is a schematic overview; no property or native-navigation pins are presented.
